claim: Automating equipment operations for nursing facilities
Automating equipment operations for nursing facilities. Founded in 2025 by Ben Rubin and Yining Zhang, Norra has 2 employees based in New York City.

Ben Rubin, Founder/CEO: Building the AI equipment operations platform for nursing facilities.  CS + Math at Rice. Spent 1,000+ hours in hospitals and nursing facilities observing broken operations firsthand.
Website description: Norra gives skilled nursing facilities an AI-powered view of owned and rented equipment to reduce waste, return unnecessary rentals, and control costs.
